messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy created by josh: config-only change 'zenith-microtune' -> limits/timeouts/routing. PR: https://git.internal/r/zenith/1234 :robot_face:
Maya P: flagged for 15m canary in us-west, 5% traffic
Josh L: microtune params: batch_max=8, prefork=2, kv_cache_ttl=30s, request_timeout=3s
Ryan C: can we keep fallback to baseline model for >95th latency? add routing policy weight fallback
Maya P: ack. suggested rollout: 5% -> 25% after 10m -> 100% after 1h if no regressions
SRE Oncall: watching latency and error-rate. set alert thresholds: p95 latency +30% and errors +0.5% -> rollback
Alina: adding origin pin for enterprise tenants: pin routing tag 'enterprise' -> baseline model to avoid regressions
Josh L: snippet config pasted:
```yaml
canary:
  duration: 15m
  steps: [5,25,100]
routing:
  policy: weighted
  fallback_model: baseline-v1
batching:
  max_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 8
timeouts:
  request: 3s
  kv_cache_ttl: 30s
```
Maya P: deploy-bot, start canary now please
deploy-bot: Deploy started (zenith-microtune) — canary 5% in us-west. Links: runbook: https://runbooks/zenith-microtune
Ryan C: watching dashboard. enabling prefix KV cache metric overlay :eyes:
SRE Oncall: set temporary escalations channel to #incidents for 1h
Alina: I patched tenant pin so enterprise still to baseline. Confirmed.
Maya P: after 12m p95 stable, errors flat. proceed to 25%? :thumbsup:
Josh L: go ahead. I'll keep eye on tail latency for rare prompts
deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 25% at 1725680065
Maya P: monitoring 10 more mins then we can promote if green
SRE Oncall: no alerts. I will authorize 100% at +50m if still green
Ryan C: note for postmortem: add latency distribution by prompt length
Josh L: thanks team. keeping rollback plan ready: revert routing weight and timeout -> baseline
Maya P: marking thread closed for now, reopen if anything odd :white_check_mark:
